column8: Thu 19 Nov: 3e wording guard if the insurer parallel is used: the same exposure as Taiwan's life insurers (FSC 2025f), never mirror image; Q10b card 2 said same sign, this kills the word.
Thu 19 Nov: twin of Q10b-019 (the insurers' stake, US$700bn+); adds the over-90%-in-dollars share and Cathay's book, store only; the FSC share is Bloomberg's report.
Thu 19 Nov: store: BIS 2021 shows the half-hedged model is a decades-old cost choice, not a 2025 accident; new source beside Q10b-020 and Q10b-021.
Thu 19 Nov: twin of Q10b-021 (hedge ratios falling); the FSC's own 47% and 45.1% upgrade its Bloomberg 45%; 42.9% is a bank's figure from Bloomberg.
Thu 19 Nov: store; if 3e must say why no one hedges fully, about 3% a year (NDF cost, CNA 2025f); extends Q10b-020; Laura cannot hedge inside the plan (Q10b-031).
Thu 19 Nov: twin of row 5 (why hedging costs); the 3% is Keel arithmetic on a slide that states no base.

Thu 19 Nov: store; fix the use: the case names no conversion date and the residency may convert as bills come (Q10b card 1; Q69 rows 31 and 35), so say the rate on the day each NT$ bill is paid, never the conversion day.
Thu 19 Nov: store: the reserve's pre-2024 mechanics; never a formula or sizing rule for her flexibility (CANON A31).

Thu 19 Nov: T3r7 note or 3e; rater reproduced 8.0%, 11.0%, 7.8% of 395 and 11.8% (Jun 2010) from the EXTAUS mirror, Keel arithmetic; the FSC's yardstick is ONE-year (a 10% one-year rise is beyond its 8.0%), the two-year 11.0% is Keel's extension; the window drives it (8j's windows 13.7%, Q10b-001 11.9% since 2001, about 24% from 1983 starts), so say on the data window Taiwan's regulator uses, never the regulator's two-year 1-in-20.
Thu 19 Nov: store: closes Q10b's gap on the 2024 mechanism's start, now read at the FSC.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e: the regulator leaned on mean reversion nine months before the reserve nearly emptied (pairs with H6-081); fix: never converted once in December 2032 (the case names no conversion date, Q10b card 1): say her contribution pays for a building from December 2032 and cannot wait years for the rate to come back.
Thu 19 Nov: store: shape-only parallel to WORDS l.37 (anything above the top goes to her flexibility); the excess is not a currency gain, and never a second image beside pencil and ink.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e or 3b, one clause of prior art: NT$283.6bn to NT$18.8bn is 93% (rater checked; FSC May 2025 release re-read by the rater: 188 (100m) after the 639 one-off); gives Q10b card 2's warning (a reserve works only if big enough) its evidence.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e or T3r7 note: 33.18 and 10.9% reproduce (FSC's 9.53% re-read by the rater), but Q10b card 1 sets the quoting convention (CBC closes, about 6% in two trading days); use the month-end 10.9% only beside the reserve figures, with its basis named; EY's 10.97% unchecked.
Thu 19 Nov: 3e support for row 13: 66% to hedges, 61% of the rest to the reserve, NT$213.9bn to results; rater reproduced 542.6, 60.6% and 213.9; at most one figure in prose.
Thu 19 Nov: store: extends Q10b-022 with May alone; the FSC release re-read by the rater shows the life insurers' five-month -61.7bn.
Thu 19 Nov: store: firm-by-firm spread for May 2025; serves no part alone.

Thu 19 Nov: store or 3b: protection counts only if in place before the move; her flexibility exists from January 2028 (VT bought then, NUMBERS 4) and needs no action; Cathay's pre-move hedge was a timing call the plan never makes; never buffer for her flexibility (WORDS l.28).

Thu 19 Nov: 3e: no one refills Laura's flexibility by rule; fix her buffer must be big enough: WORDS l.28 bans buffer and CANON A31 bars sizing it, so say it is tested against the move with no one to top it up; the quote is via NOWnews.
Thu 19 Nov: twin of Q10b-021 (the record NT$613.7bn); adds the NT$915.6bn total, store only.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e: two-sided in one year (9.53% and 4.27% reproduce 29.929 and 31.438); largely Q10b-030's reversal seen from the insurers; fix the use: say the level when the building's bills are paid, never the conversion-day level (Q10b card 1).

Thu 19 Nov: 3b: an official's own words that self-insurance needs a reservoir big enough next to the move (Q87-027's theory); quote only as about the insurers' reserve, never as a name or a second image for her flexibility (WORDS l.28).

Thu 19 Nov: T3r7 note or 3e, answers why 10% from Taiwan's own market (Cathay's 11.4% reproduces); say Taiwan's insurers say their reserves absorb a 10-12% rise (one-year, interested parties, on a half-hedged book), never design size or a standard; never 2.5 times (8j) alone, since a 10% stronger NT$ came with a median 22.3% rise in the building's US-dollar cost, $3,075 to spare (8q, Q131 block; row 35).

Thu 19 Nov: 3b: 52% and 2.5 times reproduce, but the bases differ (a realised move after a 63% hedge, refilled by rule, against MODEL central pots and a tested 10%); print only with both bases and beside 8j's 99.74% and 8q's joint test, never theirs too small, hers big enough.
Thu 19 Nov: store or 3e: Fitch read at source pairs with Q10b-025 (Taiwan Ratings via the CBC) and adds that a persistent move, not a spike, tests a reserve.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e aha if the insurer parallel is used: their two defences (they can wait; losses on paper) are the two she lacks; fix: never her buffer is sized against the move (WORDS l.28; CANON A31), say her flexibility is tested against a move, not a forecast; never converted once in December 2032 (Q10b card 1; Q69 rows 31 and 35), say it pays for a building from December 2032.
Thu 19 Nov: store or 3e: named forecasters split and CTBC's about NT$30 missed (year closed 31.438); extends Q10b-029 and Q10b-030; supports testing a level, never forecasting one.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e: the central bank will not preset a line against appreciation, so a US-dollar top cannot promise NT$ building and IPS l.15 gives that job to her flexibility; extends Q10b-027 with the bank's own denial.
Thu 19 Nov: store: one economist via Bloomberg; smoothing is not a guarantee, May 2025 broke the perception.
Thu 19 Nov: store: the CBC's own text extends Q10b-024; serves no part.
Thu 19 Nov: twin of Q10b-016, upgrading its FSC denial from search excerpt to read at source; still conflicts with Q10b-017.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e risk to record, abstract only, Taiwan untested; add Taiwan's counter-case: in the 2008 crash the NT$ weakened 12.8% (Jul 2008 to Mar 2009, Q69-036) and the squeeze came in the rebound (8j, 8q); April 2025 fits the channel; say a jump can come while shares are low, never in every slump.

Thu 19 Nov: store: Taiwan's insurers swapped Japan's reinvestment risk (H4-011, Q65-008) for a currency risk; the ladder meets sufficient without reinvestment (NUMBERS 2); the CBC liability figure is an unverified reprint.
Thu 19 Nov: store: blog estimate read in part; say Laura's Treasuries are held to their dates, never an iBond fund's payout as fixed (NUMBERS 3).

Thu 19 Nov: 3e, the corrective to rows 23-24: insurers face the currency alone, she faces currency and building costs; 30 windows, 9.3%-29.0%, median 22.3% match NUMBERS 8q's Q131 block; a past median, never a forecast.
Thu 19 Nov: store: the 97.5% or 99.5% plan is an unverified newspaper reprint; only the cap's removal (FSC 2026a) is verified.
Thu 19 Nov: store: extends Q10b-023 with the 2026 formulas; serves no part.
Thu 19 Nov: store: say since 2012 if ever needed; an official's spoken 2013 conflicts.
Thu 19 Nov: store: the governor's words as reported; move sizes stay Q10b card 1's CBC and H.10 figures, never Bloomberg's since the 1980s.
Thu 19 Nov: 3b and 3e wording: the insurers' reserve is a currency reserve; her flexibility is never a reserve, buffer or cushion (WORDS l.28); restates WORDS, so F2.
